title: Number of orders
statementMd:
How many orders exist in total?

Expected columns: `order_count`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders;
```
